name: Fortune Teller / 占卜师
ability_text: Up to 2 times per game, choose 2 players at night. The GM tells you SAME FACTION or DIFFERENT FACTION.
win_condition: Good wins immediately when all 3 Evil players are eliminated.

name: Detective / 侦探
ability_text: Once per game at night, investigate 1 player. The GM answers GOOD or NOT GOOD. Shadow Mage counts as NOT GOOD.
win_condition: Good wins immediately when all 3 Evil players are eliminated.

name: White Witch / 白女巫
ability_text: Once per game at night, protect 1 player from a normal Evil night kill. You cannot protect yourself.
win_condition: Good wins immediately when all 3 Evil players are eliminated.

name: Night Watcher / 守夜人
ability_text: Once per game, after all Night actions, choose 1 player. The GM answers YES if that player ATTEMPTED an active personal Role Skill that Night, including a Web-blocked attempt; otherwise NO. Waking alone does not count. The normal Evil faction Night Kill does not count.
win_condition: Good wins immediately when all 3 Evil players are eliminated.

name: Ghost / 幽灵
ability_text: When eliminated, you may give one final statement of about 10 seconds before leaving the main game.
win_condition: Good wins immediately when all 3 Evil players are eliminated.

name: Black Cat / 黑猫
ability_text: The first normal Evil night kill against you fails. Daytime vote elimination still kills you normally.
win_condition: Good wins immediately when all 3 Evil players are eliminated.

name: Pumpkin King / 南瓜王
ability_text: Once per game, PUBLICLY declare Royal Vote before ONE Day Vote OR ONE Final Hunt judgment. Your vote counts as 2 for that ballot. A tie revote keeps your double vote. Mummy Curse makes your vote count as 0. This Final Hunt option is an event rule extension; you cannot use Royal Vote twice.
win_condition: Good wins immediately when all 3 Evil players are eliminated.

name: Mummy / 木乃伊
ability_text: Once per game at night, curse 1 player. That player may still speak the next Day, but their vote does not count.
win_condition: Good wins immediately when all 3 Evil players are eliminated.

name: Werewolf / 狼人
ability_text: While alive, you are the Pack Leader for the Evil night kill. Once per game, Blood Moon makes the Evil night kill ignore normal protection or night-kill immunity, including White Witch Protection, Black Cat Nine Lives, and Shadow Mage's Shadow Veil. If you die, the remaining Evil players can still perform the normal Evil night kill.
win_condition: Evil wins immediately when all 4 God roles OR all 4 Civilian roles are eliminated.

name: Masked Guest / 蒙面客
ability_text: The first faction investigation against you treats you as GOOD. After that first investigation, the disguise breaks and later investigations reveal Evil normally.
win_condition: Evil wins immediately when all 4 God roles OR all 4 Civilian roles are eliminated.

name: Spider Queen / 蜘蛛女王
ability_text: Once per game at Night, choose 1 player. Web blocks that player's personal Role Skill for the Night. If a limited-use skill is ATTEMPTED while Webbed, its use is still consumed; skipping the skill preserves its charge. Web does not cancel normal speaking, daytime voting, or the Evil faction Night Kill.
win_condition: Evil wins immediately when all 4 God roles OR all 4 Civilian roles are eliminated.

name: Shadow Mage / 影法师
ability_text: Once per game, activate Shadow Veil at Night. If you are targeted by a normal Evil night kill that Night, you survive. If you are not targeted, the use is still spent. Daytime vote elimination still kills you. Blood Moon bypasses Shadow Veil.
win_condition: If neither Good nor Evil has already won when the Final Bell rings, and you are still alive, trigger the Shadow Ending and win alone.
